content.title: About
content.content: Isopure is a high‑quality nutritional powder containing 100 % whey protein isolate, minimal carbs and fats, and a blend of vitamins and minerals. It is designed to support muscle recovery, maintain nutritional balance, and conveniently boost daily protein intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Isopure provides 100 % whey protein isolate, delivering over 90 % protein by weight.
The powder is lactose‑free, making it suitable for people with lactose intolerance.
Each serving contains more than 20 g of pure protein and less than 1 g of carbohydrates.
Available in several flavors such as vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry.
Isopure has undergone clinical testing confirming its effectiveness for muscle growth and recovery.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: Over 20 g of protein per serving supports muscle growth and repair after workouts.

items.title: Low carbohydrate level
items.content: Less than 1 g of carbs makes it suitable for keto and low‑carb diets.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Whey isolate is processed to remove lactose, reducing the risk of intolerance.

items.title: Fortified with vitamins and minerals
items.content: Includes B‑vitamins, vitamin C, calcium, and magnesium to support overall metabolism.

items.title: Hydration support
items.content: Easily dissolves in water, helping rapid fluid replenishment after intense exercise.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Contains whey protein, which may trigger reactions in individuals allergic to dairy proteins.

items.title: Excessive protein intake
items.content: Very high protein consumption can strain kidneys in susceptible individuals.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Some flavors contain sucralose or acesulfame‑K, which may be undesirable for sensitive users.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: High calcium and magnesium levels can affect absorption of certain drugs, such as antibiotics.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix one scoop (≈30 g) with 250–300 ml of water, milk, or a plant‑based beverage. For extra calories and flavor, add fruit, nuts, or oats. Consume post‑workout or as a protein snack between meals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the lid tightly sealed to prevent moisture ingress. Discard if clumps, off‑smell, or off‑taste develop.
